long_biography.plain_text:
Taking charge of a vessel in Seattle gave Cameron Reed McDowell the opportunity to learn the Pacific Northwest and Alaska at close quarters. He ranged from Southeast Alaska towards Kodiak Island and Prince William Sound, experience that shaped his later focus on expedition-style private charters.

McDowell now combines command with ownership of an Alaska charter business. Working with a compact professional crew, he leads guest programmes built around remote coastal cruising, wildlife viewing, fishing and guided shore activities. The operation turns his regional seamanship into a hands-on hospitality service for small groups exploring Southeast Alaska.
